items.notes: All bayernlb.de/bayernlb.com URLs (PDFs and press pages) return ROBOTS_DISALLOWED in WebFetch. Offenlegungsbericht and EBA templates are group/IFRS. No secondary source with HGB single-entity figures found. VÖB chart: Konzern IFRS Bilanzsumme 276.9 bn (not usable).

items.name: Landesbank Saar (SaarLB)
items.source_doc: Finanzbericht 2025 SaarLB, Lagebericht S. 6 (Bilanzzahlen) und S. 22/24 (Aktiva/Passiva-Tabellen, Mio. EUR)
items.notes: Lagebericht der SaarLB (single entity, LBS Saar included as dependent unit). Passiva table shows Fonds für allgemeine Bankrisiken 259.0 and Eigenkapital 630.1 as separate lines summing to Bilanzsumme. Zuführung 2025: 2.7 Mio. No AT1: regulatory table shows zusätzliches Kernkapital 0.0 (Eigenmittel 1,053.9 = CET1 865.9 + T2 188.0). Stille Einlagen not mentioned. The § 340e Abs. 4 split was not reachable (Bilanz from p. 58 is beyond the extracted text). Values are in 0.1 Mio. precision. The direct wp-content PDF URL is robots-blocked, but www.saarlb.de/geschaeftsberichte serves the same PDF.

items.name: Deutsche Kreditbank AG (DKB)
items.source_doc: Offenlegungsbericht zum 31.12.2025, Tabelle EU CC2 (S. 11), column a 'Bilanz im veröffentlichten Abschluss'; CC1 row EU-3a = 2,411
items.notes: The OB states it is prepared 'als Einzelinstitut entsprechend HGB', so CC2 column a = HGB balance-sheet values (Mio. EUR). In CC2, AT1 instruments (600 Mio.) appear as a separate line from Eigenkapital 4,030, so 4,030 likely excludes the AT1. This is not confirmed: CC1 rows 31/32 show 0 for both classifications. CC2 also lists Nachrangige Verbindlichkeiten 3,658. The HGB Bilanzsumme was not found: the Bilanz (p. 316) and the HGB Vermögenslage (p. 33) are beyond the extract. Leverage exposure (KM1) is 139,299 Mio. and IFRS group total assets are 135,831 Mio.; neither is usable. Ergebnis vor § 340g und Steuern: 1,103.4 Mio. (VJ 979.1). dok.dkb.de is robots-blocked but the mirror host dok-cms.dkb.de works.

items.name: Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba), Einzelinstitut
items.source_doc: Einzelabschlüsse der Helaba 2025, Lagebericht 'Wesentliche Daten' S. 16; EN version p. 15/18
items.notes: Only an aggregate is available: 'bilanzielle Eigenmittel' (Eigenkapital ohne Bilanzgewinn, incl. Fonds für allgemeine Bankrisiken, nachrangige Verbindlichkeiten and AT1 instruments) = 10,575 Mio. (VJ 10,717). These cannot be split. Zuführung zum Fonds § 340g 2025: 15 Mio. (VJ 0). AT1 recognised in regulatory capital: 854 Mio. Silent participations exist (serviced) but no amount is given. The Bilanz (p. 65) is beyond the extract. The 2025 Offenlegungsbericht is group level.

items.name: BSK 1818 AG (ehem. Landesbank Berlin AG)
items.source_doc: Halbjahresfinanzbericht 30.06.2026, Zwischenbilanz S. 21-22 (Vergleichsspalte 31.12.2025); Jahresabschluss und Lagebericht 2025, Lagebericht S. 23-26
items.notes: Balance-sheet values for 31.12.2025 (Mio. EUR): Eigenkapital 2,026 = eingefordertes Kapital 1,200 + Kapitalrücklage 785 + Gewinnrücklagen 41 + Bilanzgewinn 0, with no AT1 line. Fonds 999 (30.06.2026: 1,000). The § 340e Abs. 4 share is not shown. VJ Fonds 899 is derived from the Lagebericht ('um 100 Mio. auf 999 Mio. erhöht'), not read from the balance sheet. VJ Bilanzsumme and Eigenkapital come from the Lagebericht 2025 Vermögenslage tables.

items.name: DZ BANK AG
items.source_doc: DZ BANK AG Annual Financial Statements and Management Report 2025 (EN), management report p. 23 (total assets) and p. 25 (equity, fund)
items.notes: Bilanzsumme only rounded (404.2 bn / 386.2 bn); the exact Mio. figure is on the balance sheet (p. 174), which was not reachable. The text says 'equity of EUR 10,926 million reported on the balance sheet' (VJ 10,735). The fund for general banking risks under § 340g is reported separately: 4,047 Mio. (VJ 3,847), Zuführung 200 Mio. The § 340e Abs. 4 Sonderposten is unchanged in 2025, but no amount is given. Whether AT1 is inside the equity figure is not stated.

items.name: Frankfurter Volksbank Rhein/Main eG
items.source_doc: Geschäftsbericht 2025 (ohne Konzern), Lagebericht S. 16-21; Offenlegungsbericht 31.12.2024 (https://atruvia.scene7.com/is/content/atruvia/Offenlegungsbericht-2024-final) CC1 row EU-3a
items.notes: DERIVED, not read from the 2025 Bilanz. VJ Fonds 1,166,000 T€ comes from CC1 EU-3a at 31.12.2024. Fonds 2025 = 1,166,000 + Zuführung 2025 of 101,400 T€ (Ertragslage table) = 1,267,400 T€; the Lagebericht says reserves are built only via § 340g allocations, and no withdrawals are mentioned. Eigenkapital = (Passiva 9+11+12 = 2,348,690 T€) minus nachrangige Verbindlichkeiten 39,705 minus Fonds 1,267,400 = 1,041,585 T€. VJ: 2,245,769 - 39,723 - 1,166,000 = 1,040,046 T€. These match the given sums 2,308,985 / 2,206,046. Caveat: the CC1 regulatory value could differ from the balance sheet. A 2025 Offenlegungsbericht was not found, and frankfurter-volksbank.de is robots-blocked.

items.name: Aareal Bank AG
items.source_doc: Geschäftsbericht Aareal Bank AG 2025 (HGB), Lagebericht S. 19 (Bilanzsumme, rounded) and S. 21 (bilanzielles Eigenkapital)
items.notes: Bilanzsumme only rounded (51.8 / 51.5 bn); the Bilanz (p. 64) is beyond the extract, also in the EN version. The decline in Eigenkapital reflects the 2024 Aareon sale gain and its distribution; the 2025 Jahresfehlbetrag is -81.1 Mio. Whether AT1 is inside equity is unclear: AT1 bond 407 Mio. (VJ 300) at regulatory level. The Lagebericht lists AT1 instruments under long-term funding together with nachrangige Verbindlichkeiten, which suggests they are outside equity, but this is unconfirmed. The Fonds § 340g is not mentioned in the reachable text.

items.name: Santander Consumer Bank AG
items.source_doc: Geschäftsbericht 2025, Kennzahlen S. 2 and Bilanzstruktur S. 15
items.notes: Eigenkapital 3,593 Mio. is footnoted 'ohne nachrangige Verbindlichkeiten und Genussrechtskapital'. Including those it is 4,000 (VJ 4,001). The Fonds § 340g is not mentioned in the reachable text (DE/EN extracts end at p. 25-28; Bilanz at p. 36). It is therefore unknown whether 3,593 includes the Fonds. Unchanged EK is consistent with a profit-transfer agreement.

items.name: Hamburg Commercial Bank AG
items.source_doc: Financial Report 2025 (combined management report, p. 19-20); Offenlegungsbericht 31.12.2025 LR1/LI1
items.notes: The HGB AG balance sheet (p. 231) was not reachable. Group IFRS total assets are 28.6 bn (VJ 33.6 bn); OB 31.12.2025 LR1 row 1 = 28,608 Mio. (group, IFRS); LI1 equity 3,957 Mio. (group). HGB AG items: release of 750 Mio. from the Fonds für allgemeine Bankrisiken in 2025, HGB Jahresüberschuss 998 Mio., withdrawal of 257 Mio. from retained earnings, Bilanzgewinn about 1,256 Mio. (dividend). With roughly 28-29 bn, HCOB is clearly below OLB (37.2 bn) and does not belong in the top 10.
